labels.budget: one round of 110 steps / 110 min for the outline and for each hole, then one fix round of 20 / 20; up to 2 tries per task

campaigns.text: Trial 10 runs scaffold v12 on six new open leaves and the calibration leaf. v12 spends GPU time where theorems are moving: a theorem whose outlines have produced no proved step after 3 GPU-hours of step attempts gets no new outline, a step that fails to compile after its fix round sends the theorem to a new outline, and a step the model believes false is written down and given up quickly. Outline tasks are told to write their outline (not a full proof) when a round ends without one, to prefer the theorem's own definitions, and not to run library searches.

campaigns.text:
Scaffold v8: v7 with what trial 6 taught. A hole whose check failed on our side costs the model no try; a counterexample found for a false hole goes into the next outline's prompt; an outline that proves the leaf ends it; holes are extracted with their types, so more of them become lemmas of their own; and an outline whose repair replaced the main proof with a hole is refused. The proof's explanation for prove2me is written from the model's own plan.

The leaves: calibration leaf p2m-3ad60f again, to compare v7 and v8 on one leaf, and open leaves p2m-aec6a2, p2m-d00cfc and p2m-115f6c (Pinsker's inequality, the hard one), one more than in trial 6. They were chosen by reading and our index; the trial's first outline is the probe.

campaigns.title: Trial 6

labels.budget: one round of 110 steps / 110 min for the outline and for each hole, then one fix round of 20 / 20; up to 2 tries per task

campaigns.text:
Scaffold v7, from what trial 5 and the outline probes taught. The outline task now starts with a plan: the method the leaf’s statement or paper names, and its steps, each a lemma in words. The outline then leaves every step as a `sorry` hole, combined by a short final proof; an outline has at most 12 holes and 300 lines. An outline that does not compile is not lost: the parts Lean rejects become holes (at most three passes), and an inline proof that is too long comes back as advice instead of a refusal.

As in v6, an outline whose hole is the leaf’s main claim is refused, every hole is first checked for a counterexample, and our index of prove2me’s library (333,690 statements) means the agent never re-proves what is already proved there and may import proved theorems.

The leaves: calibration leaf p2m-3ad60f, and open leaves p2m-dbd69f and p2m-f181df, chosen by quick outline probes. Since 15 November the node runs Qwen with multi-token prediction (MTP), which wrote long steps 1.7 to 1.9 times faster in our test on an RTX 3090.
